build_embedding_request: build an EmbeddingRequest with model name, input text list, and timeout for embedding API calls
build_embedding_request_with_caching: build an EmbeddingRequest with caching enabled and custom api_base for a specific embedding provider
build_embedding_request_with_logging: build an EmbeddingRequest with litellm_logging_obj and litellm_call_id for request tracing
build_embedding_request_with_provider: build an EmbeddingRequest with custom_llm_provider dict and api_key for a specific embedding backend
build_embedding_request_with_user: build an EmbeddingRequest with user identifier and api_version for multi-tenant embedding calls
